searchText: haha yeah no worries. i get exactly what you mean. my only thing is that chris has me working on this story and really wants me to get it done as quickly as possible (hoping to beat the news, i assume). i wrote the main the first day i was there and had fun with it, and i’m sure more opportunities will come up. i just know taking the main probably wouldn’t be a good idea with this high school story that chris wants asap. in the meantime, i’ll take anything else that gives you room to breathe a bit. and i’m sure there will be plenty of opportunities this summer to steal a few of the main stories from you lol evan petzold
